post.summary: Registers an OAuth client as an agent of a tenant, with its first grant.

get.summary:
Gets one page of audit entries, newest first. With an entityId, it gets the history of that aggregate root and
its children. With no entityId, it gets the entries of the tenant. Needs read_audit_log. A value that the caller
may not read has hidden set and no old or new value. To get the next page, send the nextCursor of this page as
the cursor. The last page has no nextCursor.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

token.description: The secret of the link. The SPA puts it in the fragment of the join URL: `/join#token=...`.

AddInviteResponseDto.description: The new invite and its token. This is the one response that has the token (INV-2).

permissions.description: The grant: the most that the agent can hold.

allowedActions.description: The actions that the caller can send for this agent now. A button in the SPA reads this list.

tenantId.description:
Only for a caller that sees all tenants. That caller must name the tenant. A tenant admin always adds to their
own tenant. If a tenant admin sends a tenant, it must be their own tenant.

clientId.description: The client ID in the tokens of the client. Case-sensitive.

mode.description:
"delegated" for a client that acts for a signed-in user, or "machine" for a client that acts for itself with
client credentials. Only a caller that manages all tenants can add a machine agent.

permissions.description: The first grant. The caller must hold each permission. No permission when it is not sent.

mediaType.description: The media type that the first bytes of the file named, for example image/png.

downloadUrl.description: A presigned URL of object storage. The browser saves the file under its name.

previewUrl.description: A presigned URL that an img element can show. Null when the type of the file cannot show in the page.

urlsExpireAt.description: The time after which the URLs stop working. Load the list again before it.

uploadRules.description: The files that an upload to this record can have.

recordId.description: The save that wrote the entry. The entries of one save have the same record id.

ordinal.description: The position of the entry in its save.

action.description: The name of the action, for example "users_exported". Null for a data change.

actorSubject.description:
The `sub` of the token of the save. It shows only to a caller with `read_audit_log_sensitive`,
because a provider can make it an email address. Null for system work.

actorClient.description: The client ID of the token of the save. Null for system work.

actorUserId.description:
The ID of the user who acted, also for a delegated agent. Null for system work, for a client that acts for no
user, and for a user with no user record yet.

actorAgentId.description: The ID of the agent that acted. Null when no agent acted.

requestName.description: The MediatR request of the save, for example "UpdateUser.Command". Null for work outside a request.

items.description: The entries of the page, newest first.

nextCursor.description: Send it as the cursor of the next request to get the next page. Null on the last page.

name.description: The property, for example "FirstName", or "Address.City" for one value of a complex property.

old.description: The value before the change. Null for a created value, for an action, and for a hidden value.

new.description: The value after the change, or the value of an action. Null for a hidden value.

hidden.description:
True when the caller has no `read_audit_log_sensitive` and the value is sensitive, or is a value that the
code no longer knows.

ClaimInviteDto.description: The token and the values of the new user. The join page fills the values from the token claims (INV-8).

name.description: The display name from the token, or null when the identity provider sends no name.

canOpenJobDashboard.description: True when the caller is an operator of the jobs dashboard at `/backwave`.

CurrentUserDto.description: The signed-in caller as the Server sees it in the access token.

name.description: The name that the screen shows, for example PNG.

extensions.description: The extensions of a file name of this type, with the dot, for example .jpg.

email.description: The email that the invite is for. Null when the admin gave none.

status.description: The stored state. A pending invite after DateTimeOffset InviteDto.ExpiresAt is expired.

isExpired.description: True when a pending invite is past DateTimeOffset InviteDto.ExpiresAt. The state on the screen reads this flag.

claimedByUserId.description: The user that the claim added. Null until a claim.

allowedActions.description: The actions that the caller can send for this invite now. A button in the SPA reads this list.

InviteDto.description: An invite as an admin sees it. It never has the token (INV-2).

tenantId.description:
Only for a caller that sees all tenants, such as an allow-listed machine client. That caller must name the tenant.
A user always invites to their own tenant. If a user sends a tenant, it must be their own tenant.

email.description: The email of the colleague. The invite requires it only when bool InviteForCreationDto.RequireEmailMatch is true.

requireEmailMatch.description: When true, only a caller whose token has string? InviteForCreationDto.Email can claim the invite.
When true, only a caller whose token has the email of the invite can claim it.

InvitePreviewDto.description: What the join page shows before the claim.

InviteTokenDto.description: The token of an invite link. It is in the body, so it is not in a log of the path or the query.

PaginationMetadata.description: The pagination data that a list endpoint sends in the X-Pagination response header.

allowedActions.description: The actions that the caller can send for this tenant now. A button in the SPA reads this list.

version.description: The version of the tenant that the caller loaded. A stale version gives 409.

maxSizeBytes.description: The largest file that an upload can have.

allowedActions.description: The actions that the caller can send for this user now. A button in the SPA reads this list.

tenantId.description:
Only for a caller that sees all tenants, such as an allow-listed machine client. That caller must name the tenant.
A user always adds to their own tenant. If a user sends a tenant, it must be their own tenant.

version.description: The version of the user that the caller loaded. A stale version gives 409.

timeZone.description: The IANA time zone of the venue, for example America/Chicago.
The IANA time zone of the venue, for example America/Chicago.

venueTimeZone.description: The IANA time zone of the venue, for example America/Chicago. The SPA shows the start in this zone.

allowedActions.description: The actions that the caller can send for this workshop now. A button in the SPA reads this list.

organizerId.description: The user ID of the member who added the workshop. Null when an agent or system work added it.

version.description: The version of the workshop that the caller loaded. A stale version gives 409.
The version of the workshop that the caller loaded. A stale version gives 409.
